description: This file contains a series of test cases for various session key utility functions and classifying functions related to session keys, including classification, backward compatibility, parsing, derivation, and validation within a larger project.

methods.name: classifySessionKeyShape
methods.description: Classifies the shape or format of a session key string into categories like 'agent', 'legacy_or_alias', or 'malformed_agent', and tests various input patterns.

methods.name: isValidAgentId
methods.description: Validates whether the given agent ID string conforms to specific rules regarding pattern and length.

methods.name: parseAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Parses an agent session key string into its components like agentId and rest of the key.

methods.name: toAgentStoreSessionKey
methods.description: Converts a given agentId and requestKey into a canonical session key string, avoiding duplication of prefixes.

methods.name: getSubagentDepth
methods.description: Determines the depth of subagents within a session key by counting specific segments.

methods.name: isCronSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key string pertains to a cron job scheduling.

methods.name: parseThreadSessionSuffix
methods.description: Parses session key suffixes to identify thread IDs or special embedded topics, returning the base session key and optional thread ID.

methods.name: resolveThreadParentSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the parent session key from a threaded session key, or returns null if not a thread.

methods.name: deriveSessionChatType
methods.description: Derives the chat type ('direct', 'group', 'channel', or 'unknown') from a session key string based on known patterns.
